official.deadline_note: The Seoul G20 Global Leaders Scholarship has no separate deadline: candidates are considered through the ordinary international admissions application, whose online window ran 5-14 August 2026 for the Spring 2027 cycle.
official.application_cycle: Spring 2027 admissions cycle (final results announced 19 October 2026); Fall 2027 dates not yet published
official.status_note: The online application period for international admissions (5-14 August 2026, KST) has closed; the Spring 2027 interview period ran 28 September to 2 October 2026 and the final result announcement is scheduled for 19 October 2026. Fall 2027 application dates are not yet published.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Benefits: full tuition waiver, monthly stipend, and round-trip airfare.
eligibility: Foreign nationals who have a Bachelor's degree (or higher) and meet one of the following
From G20 countries: having at least 1 year of work experience in the public sector
From non-G20 countries: having at least 6 years of work experience in the public sector
Graduates in a Korea Studies Programme: having a Bachelor's (or Master's) degree in Korea Studies regardless of nationality
requirements: Submit the online application by the application deadline
Submit the supporting documents as outlined in the application guidelines
No separate application for scholarship is required
documents: Online application through the KDI School international admissions system
Employment Verification form (published on the Application Documents page)
Statement of Purpose (SOP questions published by the admissions team)
Application checklist and the remaining documents listed in the application guideline
selection_criteria: Scholarship decisions are made by the Admissions Committee of the school
The scholarship is awarded to a limited number of students who have demonstrated their potential and excellence throughout the admission process
Primarily intended for working professionals in the public sector or potential global leaders
coverage: Full tuition waiver for the Master's programme
application_method: Submit the online application at apply.kdischool.ac.kr during the published admissions application period
Attach the supporting documents set out in the application guidelines, including the employment verification and, for PhD applicants, the research proposal
No separate scholarship application: the Admissions Committee considers all accepted international students for the scholarship
official.application_route: Ordinary KDI School international admissions online application during the application window; scholarship consideration is automatic, with no separate form
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Primarily intended for working professionals in the public sector or potential global leaders; the Korea Studies route is open to graduates of a Korea Studies programme regardless of nationality
official.research_requirement: A Research Proposal form applies to PhD applicants only; Master's applicants have no research-proposal requirement
official.description: The Seoul G20 Global Leaders Scholarship is primarily intended for working professionals in the public sector or potential global leaders. Scholarship decisions are made by the Admissions Committee of the school and the scholarship is awarded to a limited number of students who have demonstrated their potential and excellence throughout the admission process.
official.program_type: Graduate school scholarship of the Korea Development Institute (KDI School of Public Policy and Management)

applicant_utility.summary: There is no separate scholarship form: your ordinary KDI School admissions application is the scholarship application, and the Admissions Committee decides from the strength of the whole admission file. The work-experience gate is the real filter - one year in the public sector if you are from a G20 country, six years if you are not, or a Korea Studies degree regardless of nationality. With only a limited number of awards, treat the employment verification and statement of purpose as the documents that prove your public-sector record rather than as formalities.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mid-career public-sector professionals from G20 or non-G20 countries, and Korea Studies graduates, who want a fully covered 1.5-year Master's at KDI School in Sejong.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your route through the eligibility block: G20 public-sector experience (1+ year), non-G20 public-sector experience (6+ years), or a Bachelor's/Master's in Korea Studies
Have your employer complete the published Employment Verification form, since public-sector experience is the decisive criterion
Prepare the statement of purpose against the SOP questions published by the admissions team
Watch for the Fall 2027 application window (the Spring 2027 window closed 14 August 2026) and apply online at apply.kdischool.ac.kr
Treat the admission file as scholarship material: interviews ran late September to early October in the Spring cycle, so prepare for an admissions interview
common_rejection_risks: Falling below the public-sector work-experience threshold for your country category
Expecting a separate scholarship application and assuming consideration will happen automatically without polishing the admission file
Missing the narrow online application window, which in the Spring 2027 cycle was only about ten days (5-14 August 2026, KST)
The limited number of awards relative to admitted international students, all of whom are considered
Incomplete supporting documents, since the guidelines require the online application plus the listed documents
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The scholarship publishes tuition, a monthly stipend and round-trip airfare but no figures, so applicants should budget for Sejong living costs beyond the stipend and confirm the stipend level with the international admissions office before accepting.
document_audit: The Employment Verification form must be completed on KDI School's published format, not a free-form employer letter
Research Proposal is required for PhD applicants only - Master's applicants should not submit one and clutter the file
The application checklist published on the Application Documents page governs the final document set, and the guideline PDF carries the binding instructions
alerts: Spring 2027 final results are announced 19 October 2026, after interviews held 28 September to 2 October 2026
Admissions run Spring and Fall, but the Seoul G20 scholarship itself is Master's only - PhD admissions use other scholarship lines
Scholarship decisions rest with the Admissions Committee and are tied to the admission process, so there is no route to request the scholarship separately
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single online application during the published window plus the guideline documents; the Admissions Committee then makes both admission and scholarship decisions, with results announced on the published calendar date.
